about: Named places a visitor stands at a landmark: fast travel arrives here (eo-server validates the index), bots walk here, and the landmark-access work may read the same table. Each point is WGS84 latitude and longitude, converted to game metres through eo_data::geo (the city projection and the ground-plan scale). heading_deg is the compass bearing a visitor faces on arrival (0 north, 90 east). spread_m is the radius arrivals are spread over so friends do not stand in one another.
projection: lat = 37.778 - z / 110574, lon = -122.4194 + x / 87986.24747640654 (sf-city.json.gz meta, surveyed metres at 1:1)
